💧 Water companies want to charge you MORE at peak times — "surge pricing" for the hot days when you need water most. They'll call it scarcity. Here's the truth.

💧 Britain hasn't completed a major new reservoir since Carsington Water in 1991 — 35 years ago.
👥 In that time we've added around 12 million people (57.4m ➡️ 69.5m).
💷 Since privatisation, water firms have paid shareholders at least £52.8 BILLION in dividends.
🕳️ And nearly 3 billion litres of treated water still leak away EVERY SINGLE DAY.
💸 Your bill? Up from about £119 a year to £603 — a real-terms rise even after inflation.

This is not a drought. It's 35 years of failure to build, fat dividends instead of infrastructure, and now they want to charge you a premium for a summer shower.

Reform UK: build the reservoirs, fix the leaks, tie dividends to delivery, and scrap peak-time surge pricing on an essential of life.

Read the full piece 👇
